verdict.rationale: Zulip's REST API documents sending messages, running bots, and other actions that mirror UI functionality, indicating broad API coverage of core chat operations. However, the evidence pack lacks confirmation of full parity (e.g., admin/org settings, exports, integrations management via API) and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, weakening verifiability of completeness. missing for 10: explicit API-vs-UI parity documentation, evidence of administrative/settings actions via API, independent confirmation of full feature coverage, working OpenAPI/machine-readable spec.
